verdict.rationale: Ramp Bill Pay documents invoice capture via OCR with line-item extraction and two/three-way matching (ramp-docs-16, ramp-docs-17). Bill approvals are supported in the UI, the CLI and the Approvals API, under approval workflows that explicitly cover bills (ramp-supp-ai-agents-channels, ramp-supp-cli-agent-mode, ramp-supp-spend-controls-agents). Payment can be set per bill by ACH, check, wire or card (ramp-docs-38), and bills can be completed with Ramp payments from NetSuite or Xero (ramp-docs-27, ramp-docs-28). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of bill-specific approval routing rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end AP flow.
